meta.name: Fund BuybackBurnerV2 with 20% of a claimed fee batch (TEMPLATE)

transactions._comment: Template for the documented routine: each time the Safe claims creator fees (docs/safe-tx-claim-all-fees.json is one example), send 20% of what was claimed, per asset, to BuybackBurnerV2. This is a plain ERC20 transfer(BuybackBurnerV2address, amount) on the WETH contract (0x0Bd7D308f8E1639FAb988df18A8011f41EAcAD73) and/or the NVDA contract (0xd0601CE157Db5bdC3162BbaC2a2C8aF5320D9EEC) -- NOT a native ETH send. Compute calldata with: cast calldata "transfer(address,uint256)" <BuybackBurnerV2address> <amount>. Fill in the real BuybackBurnerV2 address (printed by DeployBuybackV2.s.sol once run) and the real 20% amounts before signing -- this file is a template, not ready to sign as-is.
